column3: The breadth of the tent is not expressed.
“walls on each side” interprets the last entrance measurement as sidewalls.
The BSB arranges thirty rooms on each of three levels.
The narrowing of the temple wall and a stairway are made explicit.
The BSB names both an outer and an inner sanctuary, where the Hebrew has “the inner temple.”
“square” supplies the width; “base” replaces the repeated length.
